screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel multi-agent system (Cardiologent) for arrhythmia assessment and management evaluated against cardiologists and an LLM judge. As it evaluates a newly proposed model/system architecture rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice, tests_practice is false.
